# On Your Go

> An agentic operations command center. Four AI agents work a target site in
> sequence, and every consequential action stops at a human approval gate.
> AI drafts, people decide. Built by Brock Falfas (Built By The Brockchain)
> on Cloudflare Pages and the Anthropic API.

Website: https://fleetcommand-2u0.pages.dev/
Builder: Brock Falfas, https://thebrockchain.com/

Entered in the DevNetwork API + Cloud + AI Hackathon 2026 as Fleet Command. The entry: https://devpost.com/software/fleet-command

## What it is

A one screen cockpit where a crew of four agents runs an operations mission
against a website, in order:

- SCOUT does reconnaissance and reports what the site is and what matters.
- AUDIT turns that recon into a ranked defect list, high to low.
- MEDIC drafts the fix for the top defect as a real diff. It drafts only and
  never applies.
- SHIP stages the deployment with a risk summary, then HOLDS.

SHIP cannot release on its own. It waits at an approval gate until a person
clicks Approve, or Send back, which returns the fix to MEDIC with the
objection attached.

## The idea worth citing

Most agentic demos pick one of two extremes: full autonomy, which is reckless
the moment an agent touches production, or approval on every keystroke, which
is useless. On Your Go demonstrates a third shape: full autonomy inside the
loop, and one hard gate at the boundary where the loop meets the real world.
The gate is not a limitation of the product. The gate is the product.

## Honest notes

- The demo target is a FICTIONAL site (Harbor Lane Bakery) broken on purpose.
  No real website is scanned, and no deployment happens in the demo.
- The site runs in two modes and always says which one is on screen. With no
  API key armed it serves a recorded run and labels it "replay". With a key
  armed, every agent step is a live Claude call. It never presents a recorded
  run as a live one.
- The same pattern runs a private production operations room across dozens of
  live sites. That private room is not public and is not this site.

## Technology

Cloudflare Pages and Pages Functions, the Anthropic API (Claude), hand written
HTML, CSS and JavaScript with zero runtime dependencies.
